metadata_strata_rule: Before protected labels/predictions, derive strata solely from OpenML task metadata: binary vs multiclass, n_instances <5000 vs >=5000, n_features <50 vs >=50, and presence/absence of missing values. Publish every occupied intersection and its task IDs; do not merge or drop strata because of outcomes.
custody: Representation/refinement learning and arm selection use official-train DEVELOPMENT only; final risk calibration uses disjoint CALIBRATION only; official OpenML test folds are protected until every task-level refinement and threshold is frozen.
primary: valid certifiability/coverage under the theorem-predicted bound on protected folds
required_discriminator: Before protected outcomes, at least one occupied metadata/geometry stratum must be predicted as tie/no-value and at least one as positive-value from DEVELOPMENT+CALIBRATION only; otherwise terminate CANNOT_CHECK_DESIGN_POWER without looking at protected results.
validity_gate: The prospectively selected statistical bound/checker must meet its predeclared protected violation-rate gate in every claimed stratum; failure is terminal and cannot be replaced by coverage alone.
promotion_gate: Across >=4 materially distinct occupied strata, theorem-guided refinement must cross the predicted certifiability boundary with useful protected coverage, obey the bound gate, and not be absorbed by the strongest information-matched learned/proxy comparator.
stop_rule: No task, fold, stratum definition, comparator, refinement coordinate, risk gate or success threshold may change after protected outcomes.
